card.name: Zero digit ending round numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 written as the last digit of a number, right after a leading digit such as 1, 2, 3, 6 or 7. It appears before units, percent signs or commas, in both measurements and doses.

modes.label: Tens in measurements
modes.description: The 0 completes a two-digit round number before a unit like metres, cubits or feet.

modes.label: Tens in doses and percents
modes.description: The 0 completes a round number before mg or percent.

card.plain: It fires on the final zero of a round two-digit number like 20, 60 or 70, just before the unit.
